name: Database load
description: Hero panel: stylised database cylinder whose liquid level tracks connection saturation (backends ÷ max), color-shifting sage → amber → rust. Side rail surfaces three at-a-glance KPIs (connections, total size, deadlocks).

parameters.name: instance
parameters.label: Instance
parameters.description: Pin a specific service.instance.id when the service has multiple replicas.

spec.template:
LIVE postgresql cluster

Total size
{{ format size.value 'bytes' 1 }}
Deadlocks
{{ format deadlocks.value 'none' 0 }} {{ pluralize deadlocks.value 'event' 'events' }}

dataBindings.name: backends
dataBindings.description: postgresql.backends — active backend processes (drives the fill height + colour).

dataBindings.name: max
dataBindings.description: postgresql.connection.max — configured connection ceiling, the denominator for the saturation gauge.

dataBindings.name: size
dataBindings.description: postgresql.db_size — total on-disk footprint summed across DBs.

dataBindings.name: deadlocks
dataBindings.description: postgresql.deadlocks — cumulative deadlocks. Anything above zero is worth investigating.
